name: Media Pruner
description: Automatically or manually deletes movies (Radarr) and series (Sonarr) added more than X days ago, respecting Jellyfin favorites, protected tags and watch status. Tags pending items and groups them in a "Leaving soon" collection.

versions.changelog: New reference date option: download date (Radarr movie file import date, Sonarr most recently downloaded episode).
Initial release: Radarr/Sonarr cleanup, Leaving soon tag and collection.
